# `wait-while-holding-lock`

<!-- rule-docs:header (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
Tier: correctness · Profile: none · Default: warning · Fixes: none · Options: none

Reports a loop that waits for shared state while retaining the lock another
visible function needs to update that state.
<!-- /rule-docs:header -->

## Why it matters

The signaling operation cannot acquire the lock, so the wait condition can never
become true.

## When it fires

The rule requires a visible matching lock and atomic state update in another
function of the same source file.

<!-- rule-docs:footer (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
## Example

```zig
const std = @import("std");

const State = struct {
    mutex: std.Thread.Mutex = .{},
    ready: std.atomic.Value(bool) = .init(false),

    fn wait(self: *State) void {
        self.mutex.lock();
        defer self.mutex.unlock();
        while (!self.ready.load(.acquire)) {}
    }

    fn signal(self: *State) void {
        self.mutex.lock();
        defer self.mutex.unlock();
        self.ready.store(true, .release);
    }
};
```
